comment: Production npm pin for the independently versioned Herdr plugin: core 0.52.0 uses the Pi 1.5.2 SDK set. The registry tarball's measured sha512 equals dist.integrity and its sha256 equals the accepted Windows-carrier core artifact. Hosts moving from herdr-checkout to npm require explicit deactivate/activate, never inherited activation; settled same-source npm installations may rebind under the plugin README's ownership conditions.
name: @junghanacs/entwurf
